decimal.note: a row filter combined with a projection that leaves out a list-of-structs column ahead of the filtered column is applied to the next column (pruneParquetSchema.Struct in table/internal), here giving the error "invalid: referenced field %!s(<nil>) was decimal(38, 9), but should have been utf8"; the workaround plans the files with the filter, reads them without it and filters the rows after the scan.
